name: Meross MSS315 (US)

radios.note: Needs an existing 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network with IPv6. We found no official mention of Bluetooth.

matter.note: Meross sells it as a Matter plug. We could not find a CSA listing that names the MSS315 model number. Meross's en-gc product page is not region-specific; the US store listing is the US source.

apple_home.note: Through Matter; Meross says a Matter-compatible hub is required for the chosen platform.

google_home.note: Through Matter; needs a Google Matter controller.

alexa.note: Through Matter; needs an Echo that works as a Matter controller. We did not confirm whether the Meross Alexa skill also covers this model.

smartthings.note: Through Matter; needs a SmartThings hub that supports Matter.

home_assistant.note: Meross doesn't list Home Assistant, and HA has no official Meross integration. Reviews show the EU version pairing via HA's Matter integration, but nothing official covers the US model.

hubRequired.note: The US listing only says a Matter hub is needed for your chosen platform. Meross's 'no hub required' wording appears on the EU listing, not the US one.

localControl.note: The US listing describes a completely local architecture for Matter. Cloud-free behaviour of the Meross app itself is not documented.

energyMonitoring.note: Real-time and historical use in the Meross app. Whether readings reach Matter platforms on the US model is not confirmed by Meross.

maxLoadWatts.note: We found no official electrical rating for the US MSS315 in Meross's pages. Check the label on the plug.

summary: Through Matter, the Meross MSS315 works with Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings; Home Assistant isn't confirmed for this US model. Each platform needs its own Matter controller, and the plug itself needs a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network with IPv6. Meross describes its Matter control as fully local. The energy meter shows real-time and historical use in the Meross app, but Meross doesn't say whether those readings reach Matter platforms. We found no official load rating, so check the label.
caveats: Needs 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi with IPv6 enabled on the router.
Each platform needs its own Matter controller, such as an Echo for Alexa or a SmartThings hub that supports Matter.
Home Assistant isn't confirmed for the US model; only reviews of the EU version show it pairing through HA's Matter integration.
Energy data is confirmed only in the Meross app.
No official load rating for the US MSS315; check the label before plugging in a high-draw appliance.
